title: AOTInductor: export first, then match dtype, stride and dynamic dims
summary: The v2.15 AOTInductor document packages a torch.export program for Python or C++ inference and requires matching dtype and stride except for dims marked dynamic.

hardware: CUDA or CPU as chosen by the AOTInductor document
conditions: Deployment question is export and packaging, not CUDA-graph lifetime

claims.description: aoti_compile_and_package consumes an exported program and writes a PT2 archive. The C++ example runs under c10::InferenceMode.
The v2.15 CUDA-graph trees document has the same SHA-256 as the existing f15b476 compiler card. That is one-file identity, not a re-mined Inductor.

downstream_impact: Inference packaging should record which dims were dynamic. A batch-size change is not evidence that rank or dtype may change.
vllm-ascend and TorchNPU do not inherit this CUDA-or-CPU packaging result.
recommendations: Do not copy upstream dashboard numbers. max_autotune in the example is not a measured gain.
validation_plan: A later authorized build would export one model, load the package, and compare eager outputs on a static shape and on the declared dynamic dim.
limitations: No package was built. Export and Inductor implementations were not read. NPU packaging is not claimed.
